text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I spotted a classmate
striking up a conversation with Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl I
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, there are actually a few girls who really admire you,
and we were wondering if you'd like to hit karaoke with us—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm busy.
Ask someone else.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl I
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching that scene reminded me of
when I first met Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: We have nothing to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're persistent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even now, we rarely talked about anything outside of training.
Still, to deepen our mutual understanding, I wanted to converse more—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Unnecessary. You're my Trainer.
Nothing more, nothing less.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
End of discussion.
Let's begin training.
choice_data_list: I want to get to know you better.
I want to get to know you better.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
............
What point is there in that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Think carefully about this.
About what it really means to pry into someone else's business.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't need you to understand me.
What good would knowing this thirst do you anyway?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have an outlet to vent
this burning drive to 'run,' that's all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...That alone is enough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she spoke, Narita Brian's gaze
was fixed on somewhere far, far in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to see a light snuffed out before my eyes again.
And I'd rather not... extinguish one with my own hands, either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Perhaps Narita Brian's 'thirst'
was something that could never be quenched in her lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...No matter where I go, no matter who I challenge,
it's never enough. The thirst only grows.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There must have been deep pain and struggle
that she carried entirely alone, where no one could see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's not enough... It's never enough...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when faced with countless horsegirls
standing in her path, that unquenchable fighting spirit—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Would surely continue to fuel Narita Brian's endless thirst
for the rest of her days.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Enough of this. It's pointless.
Quit wasting time with small talk and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: I'm sure it won't be a waste.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You... really are...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
............
...Hmph. Do whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just don't get your hopes up.
I do things my own way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...There was no need to rush.
I would take things slow and build our bond step by step.
